{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test and Release Go CLI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main, master, prod]
    tags: ["*"]

# The list of permissions is explained on the GitHub doc:
# https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-jobs/assigning-permissions-to-jobs
permissions:
  # Write permissions is needed to create a new release
  contents: write
  # allow read access to pull request. Use with `only-new-issues` option.
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  linter:
    name: Linter on a PR
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: Scalingo/actions/go-linter@main

  tests:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: Scalingo/actions/go-tests@main

  releases:
    needs: [tests]
    name: GoReleaser Build on All OS but Windows
    if: ${{ github.ref_type == 'tag' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # required by GoReleaser (https://goreleaser.com/ci/actions/#fetch-all-history)
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: "go.mod"
          check-latest: true
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
      - name: Run GoReleaser
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@a4f02ab5355a589de60d917a659ce617ed19b3de # v7.3.0
        with:
          version: "~> v2"
          args: release --clean
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          CGO_ENABLED: 0

  releases-windows:
    needs: [tests]
    name: GoReleaser Build on Windows
    if: ${{ github.ref_type == 'tag' }}
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # required by GoReleaser (https://goreleaser.com/ci/actions/#fetch-all-history)
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: "go.mod"
          check-latest: true
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
      - name: Run GoReleaser
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@a4f02ab5355a589de60d917a659ce617ed19b3de # v7.3.0
        with:
          version: "~> v2"
          args: release --config .goreleaser-windows.yaml --clean
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
",
  "rationale": "Applied P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads). The repository is a Go CLI with go.mod and go.sum, so repeated module fetching across CI runs is measurable and the lockfile can key the cache. I added an actions/cache@v4 Cache Go modules step (path ~/go/pkg/mod, key ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}) in the release jobs after checkout and setup-go and before GoReleaser, matching the measured P-LIT-GHA-CACHE experiment that added the same cache before dependency download and test and reported about 6 percent elapsed savings. Placing it after checkout keeps the cache input (go.mod/go.sum) present and valid. All existing jobs, required checks, permissions, and the GITHUB_TOKEN release flow are preserved; no secrets, privileged actions, publishing changes, or new network access are added.",

}
